description: Source code for Ethernet driver for NXP S32 Ethernet controller in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, packet transmission, reception, and configuration functions.

methods.name: nxp_s32_eth_rx_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling Ethernet receive processing in a loop.

methods.name: nxp_s32_eth_msix_wrapper
methods.description: Callback wrapper for MSI-X interrupt handling.

methods.name: get_iface
methods.description: Helper to get network interface, considering VLAN tagging.

methods.name: nxp_s32_eth_initialize_common
methods.description: Initializes Ethernet hardware, sets up callbacks, and starts receive thread.

methods.name: nxp_s32_eth_mcast_cb
methods.description: Handles IPv6 multicast group join/leave events.

methods.name: nxp_s32_eth_tx
methods.description: Transmits a network packet through Ethernet hardware.

methods.name: nxp_s32_eth_get_pkt
methods.description: Constructs a net_pkt from received buffer, handling VLAN tags.

methods.name: nxp_s32_eth_rx
methods.description: Receives a frame from hardware, processes, and enqueues it.

methods.name: nxp_s32_eth_set_config
methods.description: Sets Ethernet device configuration, e.g., MAC address.
